cues.en: Holy moly, you did it.
cues.zh: 天啊，你做到了。

cues.en: You have watched every single video, done every single exercise, I hope.
cues.zh: 看完每支影片，也希望做了每個練習。

cues.en: And you have completed the course.
cues.zh: 你完成這門課了。

cues.en: This was a pretty big one, right?
cues.zh: 這門課很大，對吧？

cues.en: If you got this far, you put in a lot of work, you put in a lot of effort.
cues.zh: 能走到這裡，表示付出了很多工作與努力。

cues.en: But for myself and Daniel, we just want to say thank you.
cues.zh: 我和 Daniel 想對你說，謝謝。

cues.en: Your time is valuable.
cues.zh: 你的時間很寶貴。

cues.en: And you decided that you want to spend your time, a big chunk of your time on this course.
cues.zh: 而你決定，把很大一部分時間投入這門課。

cues.en: So thank you for purchasing the course.
cues.zh: 所以謝謝你購買課程。

cues.en: Thank you for being part of zero two mastery because without people like you who pay for the course,
cues.zh: 謝謝你成為 Zero to Mastery 的一員。沒有像你這樣付費購課、

cues.en: who enroll in zero to Mastery and who support Daniel myself, we wouldn't be able to do this.
cues.zh: 加入 Zero to Mastery、支持 Daniel 和我的人，我們做不到。

cues.en: We would have never been able to make a course this big if we didn't have your support.
cues.zh: 沒有你的支持，就不可能打造這麼大型的課程。

cues.en: So thank you for allowing us to do this full time.
cues.zh: 謝謝你讓我們能全職做這件事。

cues.en: But most importantly, thank you for dedicating so much effort into completing this course.
cues.zh: 但最重要的是，謝謝你投入這麼多努力，完成課程。

cues.en: We know that this course wasn't easy.
cues.zh: 我們知道，課程不容易。

cues.en: We introduced some really advanced real world concepts, but we're pretty confident that instead of making a course that's super easy that anybody can finish.
cues.zh: 介紹了一些相當進階的實務概念，但我們相信，與其做一門誰都能輕鬆完成的簡單課，

cues.en: What was more beneficial to you was a course that taught you real world skills that made you valuable.
cues.zh: 教你真正工作技能、讓你更有價值，對你更有幫助。

cues.en: So I hope you feel that your journey has just begun.
cues.zh: 希望你覺得，旅程才剛開始。

cues.en: Obviously, there's so much more that you can explore, but I hope we gave you a nice stepping stone into the industry.
cues.zh: 顯然還有很多能探索，但希望這是一塊很好的踏腳石，帶你進入產業。

cues.en: Please reach out to us if you have any success stories.
cues.zh: 有成功的故事，請和我們聯繫，

cues.en: Your experience.
cues.zh: 分享你的經驗。

cues.en: We love hearing from the community and those stories are what drive us to create more and more content.
cues.zh: 我們很喜歡聽社群的故事，它們驅使我們創造更多內容。

cues.en: And remember, if you ever need help.
cues.zh: 記得，需要協助時，

cues.en: Your friends, Andre and Daniel are always going to be there.
cues.zh: 你的朋友 Andrei 和 Daniel，一直都在。

cues.en: Look how cute we were.
cues.zh: 看看以前的我們多可愛。

cues.en: Oh, and by the way, Bruno just called me, and he has a special message for you.
cues.zh: 喔，順帶一提，Bruno 剛打給我，有個特別訊息給你。

cues.en: Hey, it's Bruno here.
cues.zh: 嘿，我是 Bruno。

cues.en: Just want to say congratulations.
cues.zh: 想說，恭喜。

cues.en: You've been the best hiring decision at Keiko Corp. we've ever had.
cues.zh: 你是 Keiko Corp. 做過最棒的聘用決定。

cues.en: I'm super happy with you, the CEO.
cues.zh: 我非常滿意你的表現，執行長

cues.en: Super happy with you.
cues.zh: 也非常滿意。

cues.en: So we've decided to expand our data division in our company, and we're going to hire a whole bunch of other data scientists and machine learning engineers.
cues.zh: 所以決定擴大公司的資料部門，聘用更多資料科學家與機器學習工程師。

cues.en: And we think that you're the best fit for managing the team and being the lead of all these new engineers that we're hiring.
cues.zh: 我們認為，你最適合管理團隊，領導所有新聘的工程師。

cues.en: Congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: We're really impressed with your work.
cues.zh: 你的成果讓我們印象深刻。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: No more videos.
cues.zh: 沒有影片了。

cues.en: Go off.
cues.zh: 去吧，

cues.en: Take a break.
cues.zh: 休息一下，

cues.en: Go sleep.
cues.zh: 睡個覺，

cues.en: Go for a walk until the next time.
cues.zh: 出去散步。我們下次見。

cues.en: Bye bye.
cues.zh: 再見。
